hook: Wandering continua in the Julia set of a finite-type entire function have zero area
summary: The paper proves a measure-theoretic companion to Sullivan's no-wandering-domain theorem. Using a conservativity theorem for maps injective on an invariant set, it also shows almost every point in the renormalization core of infinitely renormalizable unicritical polynomials is recurrent. The results cover finite-type entire functions and unicritical polynomials only, not general maps.
title: Wandering continua, renormalization, and Lebesgue measure on Julia sets
